pages.title: Klein Bottle
pages.text: A bottle whose neck passes through its own side to join the base from inside, so that inside and outside are the same surface. In three dimensions it must cross itself; in four it does not. This one was built in four, so its glass never touches itself and nothing can be poured into it.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Gluing two Mobius strips edge to edge needed a fourth dimension to avoid self-intersection. The Tesseract Assembler supplied it, with exotic matter to hold the surface open while I joined them.
